minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  July 15, 2026

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission convened on July 15, 2026. Chairman
Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, District No. 1
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre, District No. 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle, District No. 3
   Commissioner Anya Christiansen, District No. 4
   Chairman Jacques Lesure, Commissioner at Large
  City Personnel present were as follows:
   Kerri Arroyo  Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. Commissioner Lesure moved, and Commissioner Alvitre seconded, that the
minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on May 27, 2026, be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Christiansen,
and Lesure
Noes: None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Yannick “Thurz” Koffi of Party in My Living Room (PIMLR) proposed a large-
  scale event “Party on the Lawn”, Saturday, February 13, 2027, aimed at
  celebrating community, featuring music, public art, wellness, gaming, youth
  programming, technology, and community storytelling.
  Commissioner Christiansen moved, and Commissioner Alvitre seconded to table the
  discussion regarding “Party on the Lawn” until the next meeting on Wednesday,
  August 19, 2026.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle,
  Christiansen, and Lesure
   Arts Commission

  VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  Noes: None
  b. Rasta Asaru EL of Creative House Gallery provided an update on the Utility
  Box Program, detailing the phases and locations of the utility boxes, and an
  update on the artists involved.
  c. Library Director Kerri Arroyo provided an update on Inglewood Public
  Library’s “Booked on Art” Summer Reading Program, highlighting Chatham
  Rabbits upcoming performance at the Morningside Park Branch on Saturday,
  July 18, 2026 from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. Kerri also provided an update on the
  Grand Finale Vertical Printing Activity on Saturday, July 25 at 1 p.m.
  d. Library Director Kerri Arroyo provided an update on the RFP-0258 Public Art
  Consultant, introducing the new art consultant for the City of Inglewood,
  Reonna Johnson of Three’s a Crowd. Kerri also shared an update on the
  Market Street Cultural District and the shift from a formal bid to an informal
  bid process.
  e. Kerri Arroyo provided an update on the Public Art Fund balance and ongoing
  projects, reporting an uncommitted balance of $1,245,000.

  PUBLIC REMARKS.
  a. Susie Garcia invited the Arts Commissioners and the public to the
  fundraiser for the Inglewood Night Market at Lalo’s Grill on Saturday,
  August 1, 2026, from 5 p.m. - 9 p.m.

  COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Commissioner Metcalf shared updates on her poetry classes at the Senior
  Center and the Poetry Palette event held as part of the Inglewood Public
  Library’s Summer Reading Program, noting that it was an enjoyable and
  well-received event.
  b. Chairman Lesure discussed his recent travels and experiences related to
  art and cultural events.
  c. The Arts Commissioners expressed their appreciation for the ongoing
  efforts to support public art and community engagement.
  d. Next Arts Commission Meeting: Wednesday, August 15, 2026, at 6:30
  p.m.
There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Lesure declared the meeting
adjourned at 7:11 p.m.
